Name: More Accurate Jodi
Author: deleted220294692
Description:
Have you ever looked at Jodi (especially at aerobics) and thought, "What! Why is Jodi so fat?" It especially doesn't make sense because she is an army man's housewife. She does most of the work around the house and moves around a ton. Also, as an army man's housewife, she would want to stay slim for Kent when he gets back.

Another thing this mod does is it makes her have brown hair—even in portraits. This makes sense because SDV has almost no brown-haired girls (Just Marnie?) and way too many gingers (it's only supposed to be a 1/100 chance), so this mod helps the problem.

What this actually does:
-Made her have Brown hair
-Made her slightly (one pixel) skinnier 
-Removed her bowlegs
-Made her beach outfit look more like her normal sprites

What it doesn't do:
﻿-Expand her chest, in any way
-Expand her waist
-In any way be NSFW

Included are CP (Content Patcher version) .xnb (Replacing the game files version)
